general.notes: Module title states Tx1310/Rx1550 bi-directional; ordering row lists Tx 1310nm FP only. Operating data rate is given as 155Mb/s and 155.52 Mbps (not Gbps). Launch power, sensitivity, and max input power notes reference 60km. Recommended operating temperature TC 0 to 70°C and TI -40 to 85°C also appear; ordering row for L9-FC315501-60CTC lists working temperature -10~70℃. Supply current Icc max 250 mA at 3.3 V; power in watts not stated. Signal detect range -45 to -35 dBm; LOS assert/deassert thresholds not named separately. Transmitter optical rise/fall time max 2.0 ns (20%-80%). Output spectrum width Δλ max 4 nm (FP-LD). Eye diagram per ITU-T G.957 STM-1/OC-3.
general.suggestions: Clarify whether bit_rate_gbps should store Mbps values verbatim (155, 155.52) or remain null when only Mbps is printed. Add package keyword 1x9 to form_factor enum if commonly used. Map Signal Detect Range (-45 to -35 dBm) to los_assert_dbm/los_deassert_dbm if policy allows inference from range endpoints.
